UDPcast Windows x64 and ARM64 build experiment - 2026-10-11

Outputs
  x64/udp-sender.exe, x64/udp-receiver.exe
  a64/udp-sender.exe, a64/udp-receiver.exe (native Windows ARM64)

Source: user-supplied C:\temp\udpcast-master, from https://github.com/a1ive/udpcast
Upstream release: 20250223. Its inherited embedded version string says 20230924.
source.zip contains the exact source used, INCLUDING the compatibility patch.
mingw-header.patch records the sole source change: include MinGW unistd.h before
defining the Windows usleep macro, avoiding expansion within system declarations.
The original user source directory was left unchanged.

Build environment
  Windows x64, existing MSYS2 bash/make; no Linux host or Visual Studio required.
  LLVM-MinGW 20261006 UCRT x86_64 host, clang 23.1.3.
  https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw/releases/tag/20261006
  Compiler archive SHA-256:
  317492c456aa27ee607a5919f1d2d38dcdc1112516a24d0bf4b00d078f52d17a
  Autoconf/MinGW path, NOT the MSVC solution. Static support libraries; generic C
  FEC enabled, x86-specific assembly disabled for BOTH targets.
  Compile flags: -O2 -Wall -DBB_FEATURE_UDPCAST_FEC; link: -static.
  Existing unused-variable warnings: pidfile and signalNumber.

Rebuild
  Run powershell -NoProfile -File .\Build.ps1
  This downloads and verifies the pinned portable compiler if absent, extracts
  source.zip, configures and builds both architectures, then copies the EXEs.
  MSYS2 is expected at C:\msys64; override -Bash if installed elsewhere.
  Its make and standard shell utilities must be installed.
  Configure results are cached in build-aarch64/build-x86_64. Use a fresh package
  extraction when changing toolchains or configure options.

Verification performed
  All four binaries: PE architecture and imported DLL inspection.
  ARM64 = machine 0xAA64; x64 = machine 0x8664.
  Imports: KERNEL32, WS2_32, IPHLPAPI and Windows UCRT API sets.
  No MSYS, MinGW, libwinpthread or separately installed VC runtime DLL dependency.
  x64: 16 MiB unicast over localhost, receiver SHA-256 matches input.
  x64: 16 MiB multicast data over loopback with FEC 8x4/64 and TTL 0, receiver
       SHA-256 matches input. Single receiver; no external network traffic.
  python test-transfer.py [--multicast] repeats these checks after rebuilding.
  Port pair 39080/39081 must be available. Tests write only local fixture files.

Limitations
  ARM64 execution has NOT been tested. Neither architecture has been tested in
  WinPE. Multi-machine multicast, packet-loss recovery and Windows/Linux
  interoperability still need testing. These are experimental binaries bundled
  with CloneDeploy; multicast imaging orchestration is not implemented yet.

Licenses
  Preserve COPYING-UDPCAST.txt, COPYING-TOOLCHAIN.txt and corresponding source.
  See the source files for their notices. source.zip is the corresponding patched
  UDPcast source; it is deliberately kept alongside the binaries for rebuilds.

SHA256.json records the packaged files before distribution.
